description: The 19-channel GOES Sounder on GOES-9 (18 infrared channels from 3.7 to 14.7 um and one visible channel, four detectors each). The curves are the operational per-detector spectral response functions distributed by NOAA OSPO.
facility_description: GOES-8 to GOES-15 were NOAA's third-generation geostationary weather satellites (GOES I-M and N-P series).

links.label: OSPO GOES Sounder Spectral Response Functions

notes: Operational SRF set per the OSPO table; file-to-channel/detector mapping from each archive's README. Band names follow SVO's GOES/Sounder IDs (IR<ch>_d<det>, VIS_d<det>); pivots agree with SVO's archived records to <0.01 %. DetectorType energy is assumed.
